instruction.text:
Insert the correct verb in the simple past.

Das simple past wird verwendet, wenn eine Handlung oder ein Ereignis definitiv in der Vergangenheit liegt. Achte auf die markierten Signalwörter.
instruction.sound: Insert the correct verb in the simple past.

atoms.b: Social media platforms ((influenced)) political opinions during the <u>last election</u>.
<u>Yesterday</u> the newspaper ((published)) a fake story.
<u>In 2018</u> she ((became)) the youngest woman to climb Mount Everest.
Martin Luther King Jr. ((encouraged)) generations with his dream of equality.

instruction.text:
Choose the simple past.

Das simple past steht bei aufeinanderfolgenden Handlungen in der Vergangenheit.

atoms.b: We ((arrived)) at the station, bought tickets, and got on the train.
He ((walked)) to the podium, looked at the audience, and began to speak.
She turned on the TV, ((saw)) the news, and was shocked.
The team ((discussed)) the problem, found a solution, and acted quickly.

instruction.text:
Fill in the gap, using the simple past.

Das simple past wird für regelmäßige Handlungen in der Vergangenheit verwendet.
instruction.sound: Fill in the gap, using the simple past.

atoms.b: As a child, I ((flew)) to Italy very often.
I ((worked)) at a café during my summer breaks.
She ((volunteered)) at the animal shelter every weekend.
They ((played)) football every afternoon after class.

instruction.text:
Fill in the gap, using the simple past.

Das simple past wird für Zustände in der Vergangenheit verwendet.
instruction.sound: Fill in the gap, using the simple past.

atoms.b: We ((grew_up)) with our grandparents.
I ((believed)) the story until I saw the truth.
They ((were)) proud of their culture.
They ((had)) a strong sense of identity.
